scenes.summary: An injured Liao the Scarless rushes at you just as you enter Qingbo Stockade. He tells you that a few Stockaders went into the wilderness but have not yet returned. The ambient Blight has suddenly become worse, and none of the Stockaders dared to venture outside to find them.

lines.text: Darkmask, you're finally here! Ignore my wounds for now. Ah Hua hasn't returned...
A fellow sprout-forager. Ah Hua's been caring for me during these couple of days since I got hurt real bad.
I didn't see him today so I asked around. Turned out he went out sprout-foraging with some of the Fam.
But we suddenly got a huge load of Blight short after they left. They're not even back yet... We're afraid, but none of us dared to start a search right now.
Of course I do. I told everyone that Darkmask's gourds are super useful. We just need to think of a way to dodge the Blight.
But still, Fam's scared, Darkmask. The Blight is getting worse. Those tiny gourds probably can't beat the bloody goop.

options: Liao the Scarless? Back on your feet?
Take a breath, Fam. Give me the details.
Do you have faith in them?
Do you have faith in our gourds?

r: Liao the Scarless? Back on your feet?
Take a breath, Fam. Give me the details.
Do you have faith in them?
Do you have faith in our gourds?

scenes.summary: After going out of the Qingbo Stockade gate, you see Zuo Guyan come rushing in. When he learns that the Stockaders lack the courage to look for their missing people, he uses an instigation technique he read about in the books and successfully encourages the Stockaders to start a search operation.

lines.text: Apologies, Endmin. I was picking up the new gourds. That took me a while.
Did you find the missing people?
A lesson from "Watchguard of Wuling". Never ignore any detail.
When I was patrolling these parts, I overheard them arguing if they should risk their lives to find their missing people.
It was a very heated argument. I think it's best if you can mediate the thing. After all, it'd be inappropriate for me to butt in...
What? Really...? But the latest protection device is capable of dealing with the local Blight. I'm always wearing one.
Oh, I got an idea!
I'm volunteering for the search party.
It's the damn badge hanging around Darkmask! Hmph. Why are you poking your nose in Stockade biz, Wulinger?
Ugh. I guess I can use another pair of eyes. Aren't you afraid of that Blight shite out there?
I'm a watchguard. That means I'm no coward 'cos it doesn't fit with our outfit.
You talk the talk. But it takes more than two for a proper search.
I got an idea.
Stockaders! I'm a badge from Wuling. Don't worry. This watchguard will find your missing Fam and bring them home!
HEY! This is Stockade biz, badge. And we don't need no Wulinger to help us out! Are we Stockaders a joke to you, huh?
I got an army of Fam with me! Lemme educate you, Wulinger. We Stockaders are FEARLESS!
Learned it by reading "I Walked On the Fringe of the Band". Having a friend on the other side makes instigation tactics more effective.
Endmin, over here!

options: The Stockaders are worried about gourd performance.

r: The Stockaders are worried about gourd performance.

scenes.summary: You find and bring the missing Stockaders back home. Liao the Scarless tells you a story from the past. It turns out that Zuo Guyan's savior has been pretty close by all this time.

lines.text: Finally, home sweet home. I'm just glad that Ah Hua and the others are alright. Gotta hand it to you, Darkmask, and that ... hmm. Where's Mister Badge?
Oh? He's already gone. Fine. I was thinking about thanking him in person.
Say, Darkmask, all those books and reading ... turned the Wulingers' brains into blight-goop, right?
I heard him talk to you. "Oh, I learned it from this book." "Ah. I got it from that book."
Reminds me of another Wulinger I've met a few years back.
Ah, yeah. There was this time when my Fam was heading back after a major haul when we heard people calling for help.
We got closer and saw a Wulinger getting roughed up by a bunch of splatters.
We saved that dude, but he kept blabbering on and on about some blight-ass books.
Told us about "The Grateful Burdenbeast" and how everyone must repay a debt of kindness.
We were busy trying to haul our loot back to the Stockade, so we just left him there. Got no time for his book-pushing.
Nothing like our Darkmask. You got none of his funny Wulinger habit.
The Fam's counting on you about the gourds. Those gadgets are truly wonderful.

options: I assigned another Wuling infiltration mission for him.
I'm very glad to hear that.

r: I assigned another Wuling infiltration mission for him.
I'm very glad to hear that.
